faq.title: A few quick answers
faq.description: The essentials about creating and managing your company website.

website.question: Do I need coding skills to create a website?
website.answer: No. Gyzora is designed to help you create and manage a company profile website without writing code.

languages.question: Can my website support Arabic and English?
languages.answer: Yes. Gyzora is designed for Arabic and English, with layouts that support right-to-left and left-to-right content.

publishing.question: Can I review changes before they go live?
publishing.answer: Yes. Your edits can be reviewed in a draft preview. The published website stays unchanged until you publish your updates.

closing.eyebrow: Make your work easier to discover
closing.title: Give your business a place to grow online.
closing.description: Bring your company profile and projects together in one clear, professional website.
